what: Scored evaluation records of proposed and invented features and of the downstream models, written by the frozen evaluators and read by the Study B and B2 analyses. Not model output: the model proposals are in the run records and ledgers. Each record is keyed by a hash of its inputs (`_key` in study_b/evaluate.py, `validate` and `downstream` in replication/b2/evaluate.py).
authority: The published Study B and B2 statistics were generated from exactly these records.
evaluator_versions: the frozen evaluator files (SHA-256 per record, `generator_sha256_frozen`); library versions in requirements-lock.txt
